title: attrs plugin bug when subclassing frozen classes
body:
Running into an internal error when type checking the following attrs code:

```python
import attr


@attr.s(frozen=True, auto_attribs=True)
class A:
    foo: int
    bar: str


@attr.s(frozen=True, auto_attribs=True)
class B(A):
    baz: int
```

This code when run works as expected:

```python

>>> thing = B(foo=1, bar='hi', baz='bye')
>>> thing.foo = 2
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
  File "/Users/jliu/Projects/lyft/coupons/venv/lib/python3.6/site-packages/attr/_make.py", line 351, in _frozen_setattrs
    raise FrozenInstanceError()
attr.exceptions.FrozenInstanceError
```

Running mypy on this code yields the following error:
```
$ mypy -s --strict-optional --warn-no-return --show-traceback --html-report build app/test.py

Warning: --silent-imports has been replaced by --ignore-missing-imports --follow-imports=skip

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/mypy", line 11, in <module>
    load_entry_point('mypy===0.570-dev-064c8d3301f8fab0769f12f4b1bb04a7fd7ae0de', 'console_scripts', 'mypy')()

    main(None)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.6/site-packages/mypy/main.py", line 80, in main
    type_check_only(sources, bin_dir, options, flush_errors)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.6/site-packages/mypy/main.py", line 129, in type_check_only
    flush_errors=flush_errors)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.6/site-packages/mypy/build.py", line 180, in build
    result = _build(sources, options, alt_lib_path, bin_dir, saved_cache, flush_errors)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.6/site-packages/mypy/build.py", line 266, in _build
    graph = dispatch(sources, manager)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.6/site-packages/mypy/build.py", line 2112, in dispatch
    process_graph(graph, manager)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.6/site-packages/mypy/build.py", line 2413, in process_graph
    process_stale_scc(graph, scc, manager)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.6/site-packages/mypy/build.py", line 2589, in process_stale_scc

  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.6/site-packages/mypy/build.py", line 1947, in semantic_analysis
    self.manager.semantic_analyzer.visit_file(self.tree, self.xpath, self.options, patches)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.6/site-packages/mypy/semanal.py", line 294, in visit_file
```

@euresti I believe you worked on this recently so tagging you (thanks for getting this in btw!)
